title: Squares of a Sorted Array
summary: Provide an array containing the squared values of each element from a sorted integer array, ensuring the output array is also sorted in non-decreasing order.
statement: Provide an array containing the squared values of each element from a sorted integer array, ensuring the output array is also sorted in non-decreasing order.
constraints: nums is sorted in nondecreasing order.
Return the squares in nondecreasing order.
hints: The largest remaining square is always at one of the sorted array’s endpoints.
Compare absolute endpoint values and fill output from right to left.
Place the larger square, move that pointer, and decrement the output index.
Removing the largest absolute endpoint preserves the same invariant on the remaining interval.
editorial: Removing the largest absolute endpoint preserves the same invariant on the remaining interval.
